name: channels
label: Channels
help: Up to 100 channels. Names use A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and _ - = @ , . ; such as orders, private-user-42 or presence-room-1.

name: event
label: Event name
help: Up to 200 characters, such as order-shipped. Names starting with pusher: or client- are reserved.

name: data
label: Data
help: Sent to every subscriber as is, usually JSON such as {"id": 42}. At most 10 KB (more on paid plans).
